item.title: Lindsay Clancy trial: A family tragedy examined
item.description: As the Lindsay Clancy trial begins, Natalie Morales and WBZ-TV reporter Kristina Rex examine the case that has drawn widespread attention.

item.title: Sean Hannity delivers eulogy for late friend Lindsey Graham at funeral
item.description: Sean Hannity eulogized his friend and frequent guest Lindsey Graham at the senator's funeral in Washington, D.C. on Tuesday.

item.title: Larry Millete verdict: Guilty of first-degree murder in Maya Millete case
item.description: Over five years after Maya Millete vanished from her Chula Vista home, a jury convicted her husband Larry of first-degree murder.

item.title: Netanyahu and Zelenskyy hold separate White House meetings with Trump
item.description: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu met separately with President Trump on Tuesday amid ongoing Middle East conflict.
